description: Render session status as a visual dashboard, never prose alone. Use when the user types /status-update or asks "where are we", "status?", "what's left", when reporting progress mid-way through a multi-item run (queue, standup, migration, review sweep), and at any wrap-up that summarizes more than one unit of work. Standing rule: status is ALWAYS a dashboard plus a 2-3 line TLDR, never prose alone. Prose stays for reasoning, judgment, and things needing a decision — state and completions get rendered, not narrated.
